record.text:
Technology needs to be reliable. 

Right now, the entire consumer industry is in a battle against technology becoming more unreliable and expensive day-by-day. And while the iPhone Duo might be a lovely product, it feels socially out of touch with the reality of people's incomes and the economy.

Let me know when the iPhone Duo is sub $1000 or whatever. Or Apple has a flip model at or around that price. 

The iPhone 17 was already pushing the ABSOLUTE limits for me, and I only got it because it was through my mobile provider on a trade in deal. And that was before the cost went up $100.

My feelings on the iPhone Duo are that it is a fascinating piece of product, and Apple will probably do the folding phone concept better than Samsung or anyone else. But I am most definitely not interested at $2000. I need phones to be reliable and durable, not expensive and breakable.
